subject: french
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: What does « la fête nationale » in France refer to?
questions.explain: « La fête nationale » is Bastille Day, le 14 juillet.

questions.q: What does 'assister à un concert' mean?
questions.explain: False friend: 'assister à' means 'to attend', not 'to assist'. 'To help' is 'aider'.

questions.q: How do you say « I gave up smoking »?
questions.explain: « Arrêter de fumer » means to give up / stop smoking.

questions.q: What does « un ordinateur » mean?
questions.explain: « Un ordinateur » means a computer; « un ordinateur portable » is a laptop.

questions.q: What does « mon jumeau » mean?
questions.explain: « Un jumeau » means a twin (« une jumelle » for a female twin).

questions.q: What does « le carême » mean?
questions.explain: « Le carême » is Lent, the fasting period before Easter.

questions.q: What does « répéter » mean for a band or play?
questions.explain: « Répéter » means to rehearse (« une répétition » = a rehearsal); it also means to repeat.

questions.q: How do you say 'I exercise to keep fit'?
options: Il fait de l'exercice pour rester en forme
Je fais de l'exercice pour rester en forme
Je fais de l'exercice parce que je suis en forme
Je fais de l'exercice pour grossir
questions.explain: 'Rester en forme' = 'to keep fit' and 'pour' = 'in order to'; 'je fais' is the correct first-person form.

questions.q: What does « un dessin animé » mean?
questions.explain: « Un dessin animé » means a cartoon (animated film); a comic strip is « une BD ».

questions.q: What does « bricoler » mean?
questions.explain: « Bricoler » means to do DIY or tinker with things; « le bricolage » is DIY.

questions.q: What does « une blessure » mean?
questions.explain: Faux ami: « une blessure » means an injury/wound, not a blessing.

questions.q: What does « les informations » (« les infos ») mean?
questions.explain: « Les informations » (« les infos ») means the news on TV/radio.

questions.q: What does « se muscler » mean?
questions.explain: « Se muscler » means to build up / tone your muscles through exercise.

questions.q: What does 'J'ai l'habitude de lire le soir' mean?
options: I usually read in the evening
I used to read in the evening
I would like to read in the evening
I have to read in the evening
questions.explain: 'Avoir l'habitude de' means 'to be in the habit of / usually do', so this is 'I usually read in the evening'.

questions.q: What does « la lecture » mean?
questions.explain: False friend: « la lecture » means reading (the activity), not a lecture (which is « une conférence/un cours »).

questions.q: What does « les yeux noisette » mean?
questions.explain: « Noisette » (hazelnut) describes hazel-coloured eyes.

questions.q: What does 'le temps libre' mean?
questions.explain: 'Le temps libre' means 'free time'. Note 'le temps' can also mean 'weather', but 'libre' (free) makes it 'free time' here.

questions.q: What does « les cheveux frisés » mean?
questions.explain: « Frisés » means curly; straight hair is « raides ».

questions.q: What does « un abonnement » mean?
questions.explain: « Un abonnement » means a subscription, e.g. « un abonnement à une plateforme de streaming ».

questions.q: What does « un mot de passe » mean?
questions.explain: « Un mot de passe » means a password (literally a word to pass).

questions.q: What does « la Toussaint » celebrate?
questions.explain: « La Toussaint » (1 November) is All Saints' Day.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'My parents are divorced'?
questions.explain: 'Divorcé' = divorced; 'marié' = married and 'fiancé' = engaged are near-miss distractors.
